reason: For a legal input (distinct starter ids), the laws fix the kept registry prefix, the exact set of added ids (all absent starters, only absent ones), their order (a sublist of the starter ids with distinct ids), and every field of each added row: id, adapter and model come from AddsOnlyAbsent, and enabled is false without --enable or on a locked adapter, and the starter flag otherwise. So two designs that pass all laws give the same registry.
